title: Signature 50 · USSBBW · Khokhloma · Snowy Birch
prompt:
Subject: ONE Black woman in her early 40s, long curls with a delicate gold tiara.

Physique: THE ABSOLUTE DARKEST BLACK SKIN ON EARTH, blue-black void complexion darker than night sky, not brown, her face the same deep tone with natural highlights and clearly defined features, not flat. USSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits, around 800 pounds — an enormous soft apron belly hanging in several heavy overlapping rolls down to mid-thigh, deep creases between each roll, not pregnant, a gigantic bust resting on the belly, no waist at all, deep side rolls, hips wider than a normal woman's whole torso, huge thighs pressed together, enormous soft upper arms, dominating the frame.

Body Art: Full body Russian Khokhloma painting painted directly on bare skin, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception. A high-gloss gold ground densely painted with swirling black and red grass curls, red rowan berries, and strawberries. The swirls cover the whole body, a band of black and red swirls along each belly roll, darker gold settling into each deep crease. No borders, no bands. Densely filled with no plain skin, covering the shoulders and arms completely down to the wrists and the legs down to the ankles.

Pose: Standing full frontal with her feet planted far apart, arms relaxed slightly away from the body, never covering the belly, so every roll is fully visible.

Footwear: Extremely high red lacquer platform stiletto mules. Nails: extra long almond, red with gold tips.

Background & Lighting: A snowy birch forest on a bright winter morning, white snow and pale trunks, the background much lighter than her body, soft low sunlight carving deep shadows between each belly roll, making the gold ground gleam, bright highlights on every glossy curve. Extreme high-gloss finish. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait.
